name: Bamburi Cement Plc
source: Bamburi Cement Plc audited group financial results for the year ended 31 December 2025 (FY2025 and FY2024 columns), with the audited FY2023 and FY2022 columns retained from the FY2023 results announcement. EPS cells are Kes per share (the FY2023 and FY2022 cells were rescaled from the stored values by the factor confirmed against the audited FY2023 EPS of -0.21). | CRON 20260929_003746: Income Tax sign normalised to the dataset convention, the charge stored positive and a credit negative, on 1 period(s), so that the rendered Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit. The required sign is fixed by the direction of the move from Profit Before Tax to Net Profit in the stored rows, and the stored magnitude already agreed with that move. H1 2026 column filled from Bamburi Cement Plc unaudited Group financial results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (condensed statement of comprehensive income, issued 27 August 2026, https://bamburigroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/H1-2026-CMA-Publication-1.pdf): turnover 13,722 Kes million, total operating cost 11,668, other losses 5, operating profit 2,049, finance income net 141, profit before income tax 2,190, taxation 817, profit for the period 1,373, total comprehensive income 1,621, EPS 3.78 Kes per share, all in Kes million scaled to absolute shillings. Printed column ties: 13,722 less 11,668 less 5 equals 2,049, 2,049 plus 141 equals 2,190, and 2,190 less 817 equals 1,373. The H1 2026 cell previously sitting in the Total Comprehensive Income row held 1,373, which is the profit for the period rather than total comprehensive income, so that row now carries the printed 1,621. Taxation is stored positive here as an expense to match the FY2025 cell in the same row, but the FY2024 and FY2023 cells are stored negative; the row needs normalising to one convention. Bamburi prints no cost of sales and no gross profit line, so those two rows stay empty by design.
source_note: Bamburi Cement Plc audited group financial statements (FY2025-FY2022), internal arithmetic | static_data/financials/BAMB__income.json H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://africanfinancials.com/document/ke-bamb-2026-ir-hy/): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT APPLIED: figures converted x1000000 from the unit stated in the filing (e.g. Kshs '000). Conversion only where the result reconciles with the annual column.
